sources.dataVersion: 2026 catalog/URL distribution; GeoJSON collection name ends in 2025; object last modified 2026-08-07. The publisher does not explain this discrepancy; it is not presented as confirmed 2026 map content.
sources.scope: Published public-coordinate registry-map polygons for Himeji (28201). The complete paired SHP geometry member is streamed and verified at runtime; arbitrary-coordinate sheets are excluded by the publisher. Bounded qualification and app checks do not establish citywide completeness. Locator remains the immutable WUP point and may have no containing parcel.

identity.recipe: Lowercase SHA-256 of the unchanged little-endian SHP geometry record content, excluding its 8-byte record framing. This includes geometry type, source-derived bbox, ring indices and every native double coordinate, with no row number or byte offset in the identity. Prefix with source ID + /native-shape-sha256-v1/. Identical native geometries deduplicate; source corrections/reordering of coordinates change references.
identity.reason: ID repeats across source sheets. Geometry-derived references allow anonymous geometry-only SHP reads without requesting any DBF attributes. These are source geometry references, not legal parcel identifiers.
identity.stabilityLimits: Stable for unchanged native SHP record geometry in this pinned release; identical record geometries share a reference. Corrections, coordinate or ring reordering can change references; cross-edition continuity is not asserted.

projection.operation: JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS V inverse Transverse Mercator to longitude,latitude on GRS80, used as geographic WGS84 display coordinates without fitted offset.
projection.uncertainty: JGD2011 epoch/datum transformation to WGS84 and external basemap alignment are not independently surveyed; second-pass follow-up.

jurisdiction.basis: Current first-party CKAN package 兵庫県-姫路市 explicitly describes MOJ registry-office map conversion, public-coordinate sheets only, JGD2011.

discovery.pairedFormatEvidence: The live CKAN resource list contains both the immutable receipt GeoJSON endpoint and the same-stem 2026 SHP ZIP. Runtime reads only that ZIP geometry member; no DBF is fetched.
